title: 第8章 三副碗筷

第8章 三副碗筷
拾荒者营地内，雷队在前，许青在后，阳光正浓洒落大地，落在他们身上。
远远看去一高一矮，一老一少，竟隐隐还有一些融洽之意。
似乎在这残酷的世界里，这样的融洽很难得。
又或许是雷队手中的蟒尸具备了威慑，以至于四周不曾去斗兽场的路人，在看到后，大都没有去打扰。
许青很喜欢这种感觉，无论是接下来的吃蛇，还是此刻阳光的拂面，都让他觉得暖洋洋的。
很舒服，很期待。
而每次目光落在雷队抓着的蟒尸时，他都嘴巴里口水分泌更多。
他也喜欢吃蛇。
雷队的家，在这营地的中环部分。
相对于内环区域的砖瓦屋舍，外环部分的简易帐篷，中环区域的住处大都是石木结构，且是三间小屋排列在一起。
每一间虽都不是很大，可看去时也远比许青在贫民窟时好了太多。
尤其是雷队的住处，还有一个小院，这就更难得了。
此刻推开竹院的门，在许青的观察与打量下，雷队拎着蟒尸走向尾房，随手指了下第二间小屋。
“小孩，你以后就住那里吧，你自己先熟悉熟悉，一会饭好了我喊你。”
说着，雷队就进了偏房，不多时便有剁肉的声音传出。
许青咽了下口水，先是在这小院里仔细的观察一番，随后走进第二间小屋，里面有一张床，一套被褥，一副桌椅，此外别无他物。
地面很整洁，桌椅也没有灰尘，显然经常被人擦拭，而被褥也明显洗的很干净，上面还有一股被阳光晒过的味道。
这一切，让许青很满足。
他不喜欢大的房舍，他喜欢那种自己一眼可以看见所有，仿佛能将一切折射在脑海里的小屋子。

这样更让他觉得安全。
于是仔仔细细的检查一番后，许青看着干净的床，想了想没有过去，而是直接坐在了地上。
盘膝闭目，开始今天的修行。
在这修行中，随着灵能的涌入，他耳边还传来隔壁尾房里噼里啪啦的沸油声。
很快阵阵香气就顺着墙壁的石木缝隙，飘了进来，弥漫了小屋的同时，也勾出了许青肚子里的阵阵干瘪之音。
许青喉咙不由自主的动了一下，睁开眼看向尾房的方向。
多年的贫民窟生活，他已经记不得上一次闻到这样的香味是什么时候了。
于是他强忍着肚子里传出的渴望声，闭上眼，让自己平静下来，继续修行。
就这样时间慢慢流逝，很快黄昏到来。
当屋舍外传来雷队呼唤开饭的声音后，刚刚结束一天修行的许青，眼睛飞速睁开。
他站起身快步走出屋舍，看到了雷队站在偏房门口，冲着他招手。
顺着雷队身侧的空旷，许青已经看到了屋舍内的饭桌上，已然摆放了七八份不同种类的蛇宴，有油炸，有红烧，有清蒸，还有蛇羹。
显然雷队具备了一手极好的厨艺，色香味俱全。
许青看了眼，目光就有些直，雷队笑了笑，转身进去拿起碗筷摆放。
许青也立刻靠近，随着走入这尾房，香味更浓，但他没有立刻坐下，而是等雷队将碗筷摆好后，眼睛忽然一凝。
碗筷，是三副。
“还有其他人？”香味即便是再具备诱惑，此刻随着三副碗筷的出现，也都被许青刹那隔离在身体之外。
他谨慎的看向雷队，轻声问道。
“不用紧张，这是我的习惯，那是一个……永远也不会来的人。”
雷队淡淡开口，目中深处有追忆之芒出现，又很快消失，坐在了椅子上。

许青点了点头，随着坐下，再也忍不住一把抓起一块油炸的蛇肉，放在嘴里大口撕咬。
很烫，但他吃的很爽，满口流油。
刚吃完一块，他就舔着嘴巴上的油脂，要去抓红烧蛇肉，雷队轻咳一声。
“用筷子。”
“哦。”许青笨拙的拿起筷子，适应了一下后，插着一块红烧的蛇肉，大口吞咽。
整个吃饭的过程二人都没有说话，只是吃相很不和谐。
雷队细嚼慢咽，不像是一个拾荒者，每一道菜也就是吃三两口，而许青那里狼吞虎咽，食量之大超过雷队太多。
看着许青这么去吃，雷队忍不住开口。
“怎么不像之前给你馒头时，那么小口小口的吃了？”
许青用力将口中的蛇肉吞下，抬头望着雷队，很认真的回答。
“馒头是你的，蛇肉是我的。”
一个是别人的食物请自己吃，一个是自己的食物请别人吃。
少年简单的思维里，属于自己的物品，自然吃起来更名正言顺。
雷队闻言哭笑不得，看着许青在那里用筷子不断地戳着蛇肉，喝着蛇羹，但也注意到少年并没有去动每一道蛇宴里，靠近他这边的部分，蛇羹也喝的有所克制。
他只是将属于他的那一份，吃的理直气壮。
“你那条蟒蛇，分量很足，应该可以够吃半个月了，且蛇皮蛇骨也有不小的价值，所以……”雷队随意的说了一句。
“房租我会给的，不用以此抵扣。”许青忽然开口。
蛇肉是报答一路的馒头与睡袋，蛇皮蛇骨的价值则是报答对方帮自己遮盖了残牛帐篷之事。
至于对方带自己离开废墟，进入营地，这是恩惠，是人情。
许青觉得用物质去抵消，有些不妥，所以记在了心里。

雷队深深的看了许青一眼，看出了他目中的认真以及那股恩怨分明的想法，于是点了点头，思索后，再次传出话语。
“小孩，想必一路上，你对我这里也有很多猜测。”
许青没说话，但吃咽的举动微微缓了一下。
“别人都称呼我雷队，至于名字，不重要，拾荒者营地内，没有人会用真名。”
雷队夹起一块清蒸蛇肉，放在嘴里慢慢咀嚼。
“之所以有这个称呼，是因我在这拾荒者营地内，有几个可以托付生死的朋友。”
“我们组成了自己的小队，小队的名字比较俗，叫做雷霆。”
“平日里大家各自接活儿，若遇到难度较大的，则全队聚集去完成，算我在内，一共四人，如今他们三个都外出还没有回来。”
“等回来后，我给你一一介绍，以后你跟着我们，作为小队新晋成员，去接活赚生存与修行的资源。”
雷队似乎有些吃饱，放下筷子，看着许青。
他话语的最后五个字，许青没有意外。
许青觉得自己能察觉雷队是散修，那么接触这么久，哪怕自身是炼体，但对方观察之下，自然也能察觉他的底细。
“好。”许青没有迟疑，点头说道。
这也让他心底松了口气，在贫民窟长大的他深刻的知晓，这世界上没有无缘无故的奉献与帮助，一切都必有原因。
“你继续吃吧，我老了，吃多了消化不了。”
雷队咳嗽了几声，面色有些潮红，但很快就恢复，站起身向外走去，口中传出话语。
“这世界的灵能如毒药一样，你一路上那种刻苦的修炼，很有可能自身没走多远，就已经被异质异化了，修行要稳扎稳打，不能激进。”
许青沉默，没说话。
走到门旁的老者，转身看了看许青，摇了摇头。
“不过你这么修炼，也是对的。”

“拾荒者的营地与旁边的禁区，与你之前所在的地方不一样，因禁区内的物产，使得这里更多是低阶散修以及亡命徒的汇聚处。”
“你居住在这里，必定也要去禁区走一遭，多修炼也好。”
雷队离开。
许青独自坐在那里，直至将所有的蛇肉都吃下后，他没有立刻离去。而是将碗筷收拾一番，清洗干净放好后，才回到了自己的小屋。
盘膝坐下，继续修炼。
许青很清楚，若不想苟延残喘，去弯腰生存，将生死的权利掌握在别人手里，那么自身的实力就是一切的根本。
尤其这拾荒者营地内，散修不少，比他六年来加起来看到的还要多，每一个都不是善茬.
如果贫民窟是狗窝的话，这里就是狼穴。
如不努力，那么还没等异化，就会因为一场矛盾或者纷争，死无葬身之地。
至于异质，许青在海山诀竹简山知晓，是有丹药可以化解的。
虽然治标不治本，但也能应对，而这种丹药的名字，他路上也已经从那些拾荒者口中谈话里知晓，叫做白丹。
附近禁区盛产的，就是制作白丹所需的重要草药，所以，这营地内必定有白丹贩卖。
想到这里，许青摸了摸胸口埋入紫色水晶的位置。
他这段时间已经清晰感受到，自身除了恢复力外，无论速度还是力量，都提升了极多。
与达到海山诀第一层有关，但许青觉得，自己这第一层，似乎与海山诀描述的一虎之力有些不一样。
“我可以打死很多老虎。”
许青喃喃，感受了一下体内的灵能，在这一路上他刻苦的修行下，似快要达到第二层。
“今晚，冲击第二层。”许青目中露出坚定，闭上双眼，开始吐纳。
很快灵能就从四面八方涌来，禁区外的灵能相对于禁区内，异质少了很多，也就使得修行速度上相对提升了不少。
这一点许青昨日在斗兽场排房内，就已经察觉。

此刻放开了身体，用力的吸收与吐纳中，他被皮袄盖住胸口也有的微弱紫光一闪一闪。
时间流逝，渐渐许青的身体内，传出了轻微的砰砰声，汗毛孔里，黑色的杂质也再一次被排出。
全身的血肉于滋养中，仿佛越发的坚韧，隐隐有更强的力量，在其内逐渐的迸发开来。
与此同时，外面的夜色中，白天被许青换了竹签的小女孩，走近了许青所在的居所院子外。
她站在那里迟疑，仿佛想敲门，但又有些忐忑。
直至许久，她似乎鼓起勇气，轻轻的敲了敲院子的竹门，只是这声音太微弱了，根本就无法传进去。
而在小女孩敲竹门的一刻，许青体内的砰砰声也达到了最强烈之时。
随着一声脑海的轰鸣，许青眼睛睁开，紫芒再一次于他目中闪耀，他神色内露出喜悦，低头看向自己的手臂，那里出现了第二个异化点。
凝气，二层。
(本章完)

Chapter 8 Three sets of bowls and chopsticks
In the scavenger camp, Team Lei was in front and Xu Qing was behind. The sun was shining thickly on the earth and falling on them.
From a distance, one is tall and the other is short, one is old and the other is young, but there is still a hint of harmony.
It seems that in this cruel world, such harmony is rare.
Or maybe the python corpse in Team Lei's hands was such a deterrent that most of the passers-by who had never been to the Colosseum didn't bother them after seeing it.
Xu Qing liked this feeling very much. Whether it was eating the snake next or the sunshine on his face at this moment, it made him feel warm.
Very comfortable and looking forward to it.
And every time his eyes fell on the python corpse held by Captain Lei, his mouth would salivate even more.
He also likes to eat snakes.
The home of the Thunder Team is in the central part of the camp.
Compared with the brick houses in the inner ring area and the simple tents in the outer ring area, most of the residences in the middle ring area are stone and wood structures, with three cabins arranged together.
Although each room is not very big, it looks much better than when Xu Qing was in the slums.
Especially Team Lei's residence also has a small courtyard, which is even more rare.
At this moment, the door of the bamboo courtyard was pushed open. Under Xu Qing's observation and size, Lei Dui carried the python corpse to the tail room and pointed to the second cabin.
"Kid, you can live there from now on. You can get familiar with it yourself first. I'll call you when the meal is ready."
With that said, Captain Lei entered the side room, and soon there was the sound of chopping meat.
Xu Qing swallowed, first observed the small courtyard carefully, and then walked into the second small room. There was a bed, a set of quilts, a table and chairs, and nothing else.
The floor was very tidy, the tables and chairs were dust-free, and they had obviously been wiped frequently. The bedding was obviously washed very clean, and there was a sun-baked smell on it.
All this made Xu Qing very satisfied.
He doesn't like big houses, he likes small houses where he can see everything at a glance, as if everything can be reflected in his mind.
This makes him feel safer.
So after checking it carefully, Xu Qing looked at the clean bed, thought for a while and didn't go over, but sat directly on the ground.
Cross your legs and close your eyes to start today’s practice.
During this practice, with the influx of spiritual energy, he heard the sound of boiling oil crackling in the back room next door.
Soon, bursts of aroma drifted in along the gaps in the stone and wood of the wall. While filling the cabin, it also evoked the dry sound in Xu Qing's stomach.
Xu Qing's throat moved involuntarily, and he opened his eyes and looked in the direction of the tail room.
After years of living in the slums, he couldn't remember the last time he smelled such a fragrance.
So he suppressed the longing sound in his stomach, closed his eyes, calmed himself down, and continued practicing.
Time passed slowly like this, and soon dusk came.
Xu Qing, who had just finished practicing for the day, opened his eyes quickly when the voice of the Lei team calling for dinner came from outside the house.
He stood up and walked out of the house quickly, and saw Captain Lei standing at the door of the side room, waving to him.
Following the empty space beside Team Lei, Xu Qing had already seen seven or eight different kinds of snake feasts placed on the dining table in the house, including fried, braised, steamed, and snake soup.
Obviously Team Lei has excellent cooking skills, and the food is delicious and delicious.
Xu Qing glanced at it and his eyes were a little straight. Captain Lei smiled, turned around and went in to pick up the bowls and chopsticks and put them away.
Xu Qing also immediately approached. As he walked into the back room, the aroma became stronger. However, he did not sit down immediately. Instead, he waited for Captain Lei to place the dishes and chopsticks before his eyes suddenly froze.
There are three sets of bowls and chopsticks.
"Is there anyone else?" No matter how tempting the fragrance was, with the appearance of three sets of bowls and chopsticks, Xu Qing was instantly isolated from his body.
He looked at Captain Lei cautiously and asked softly.
"Don't be nervous, it's my habit, that's someone who... will never come."Lei Dui spoke calmly, a light of reminiscence appeared in the depths of his eyes, then quickly disappeared and he sat on the chair.
Xu Qing nodded, and as he sat down, he couldn't help but grab a piece of fried snake meat, put it in his mouth and took a big bite.
It was very hot, but he enjoyed it very much, and his mouth was full of oil.
As soon as he finished eating a piece, he licked the grease on his mouth and went to grab the braised snake meat. Captain Lei coughed lightly.
"Use chopsticks."
"Oh." Xu Qing picked up the chopsticks awkwardly. After getting used to it, he inserted a piece of braised snake meat and swallowed it in a big mouth.
The two of them didn't speak during the whole meal, but their eating habits were very disharmonious.
Lei Dui ate his food carefully, not like a scavenger, and only took three or two bites of each dish, while Xu Qing devoured it, eating much more than Lei Dui.
Seeing Xu Qing eating like this, Captain Lei couldn't help but speak.
"Why don't you eat it in small bites like when I gave you steamed buns before?"
Xu Qing swallowed the snake meat in his mouth hard, looked up at Captain Lei, and answered seriously.
"The steamed buns are yours, and the snake meat is mine."
One is to treat yourself to other people's food, and the other is to treat others to eat your own food.
In the young man's simple thinking, items that belong to him naturally taste more legitimate.
Captain Lei couldn't laugh or cry when he heard this. He watched Xu Qing stabbing the snake meat with chopsticks and drinking the snake soup. However, he also noticed that the young man did not touch the part of the snake feast near him, and drank the snake soup with some restraint.
He just eats his portion with confidence.
"That python of yours is very heavy. It should be enough to last half a month. The skin and bones are also valuable, so..." Captain Lei said casually.
"I will pay the rent. You don't have to use it as a deduction." Xu Qing suddenly said.
The snake meat is a reward for the steamed buns and sleeping bags along the way, and the value of the snake skin and snake bones is to repay the other party for covering his tent with the broken cow.
As for the other party taking him out of the ruins and into the camp, it was a favor and a favor.
Xu Qing felt that it was inappropriate to use material things to offset it, so he kept it in mind.
Captain Lei took a deep look at Xu Qing and saw the seriousness in his eyes and the clear thoughts of grudges, so he nodded, thought about it, and spoke again.
"Kid, you must have made a lot of guesses about me along the way."
Xu Qing said nothing, but his swallowing movements slowed down slightly.
"Everyone calls me Thunder Team. As for the name, it's not important. No one in the scavenger camp uses my real name."
Captain Lei picked up a piece of steamed snake meat, put it in his mouth and chewed it slowly.
"The reason why I have this title is because I have a few friends in this scavenger camp who I can trust with my life and death."
"We formed our own team, and the team's name is relatively common, called Thunder."
"On weekdays, everyone takes on the work individually. If there is a difficult task, the whole team gathers to complete it. Counting me, there are four people in total. Now three of them have gone out and haven't come back yet."
"When I come back, I will introduce them to you one by one. From now on, you will follow us as a new member of the team to earn resources for survival and cultivation."
Captain Lei seemed a little full. He put down his chopsticks and looked at Xu Qing.
Xu Qing was not surprised by the last five words of his words.
Xu Qing felt that he could detect that Lei Dui was a casual cultivator. After being in contact with him for so long, even if he was practicing body training, the other party would naturally be able to detect his details under observation.
"Okay." Xu Qing nodded without hesitation.
This also made him feel relieved. Growing up in a slum, he knew deeply that there is no such thing as unreasonable dedication and help in this world, everything must have a reason.
"You keep eating. I'm old and can't digest too much."
Captain Lei coughed a few times, his face flushed a little, but he quickly recovered, stood up and walked outside, words came out of his mouth.
"The spiritual energy in this world is like poison. Your hard work along the wayIn your cultivation, it is very likely that you will have been alienated by other people before you have gone very far. You should practice steadily and not be radical. "
Xu Qing was silent and didn't speak.
The old man who walked to the door turned around, looked at Xu Qing, and shook his head.
“But it’s right for you to practice like this. "
"The scavenger camp and the restricted area next to it are different from the place you were before. Due to the products in the restricted area, this place is more of a gathering place for low-level casual cultivators and desperadoes. "
"If you live here, you must go to the restricted area and practice more. "
Team Thunder leaves.
Xu Qing sat there alone until he had eaten all the snake meat, but he did not leave immediately. Instead, he put away the dishes, cleaned them and put them away before returning to his hut.
Sit down cross-legged and continue practicing.
Xu Qing knew very well that if he did not want to survive, to bend down to survive, and to hold the power of life and death in the hands of others, then his own strength was the foundation of everything.
Especially in this scavenger camp, there were many casual cultivators, more than he had seen in the past six years combined, and every one of them was not a good person.
If slums were doghouses, this would be the wolf's den.
If you don't work hard, you will die without a burial place because of a conflict or dispute before alienation.
As for the heterogeneity, Xu Qing knew at Haishan Jue Bamboo Slip Mountain that there were elixirs that could resolve it.
Although it treats the symptoms rather than the root cause, it can still be dealt with, and the name of this elixir, which he already knew from the conversations among the scavengers on the way, is called Baidan.
The nearby restricted area is rich in important herbs needed to make white pills, so there must be white pills for sale in this camp.
Thinking of this, Xu Qing touched the place where the purple crystal was buried in his chest.
During this time, he has clearly felt that in addition to his recovery ability, both his speed and strength have improved greatly.
It has something to do with reaching the first level of Haishan Jue, but Xu Qing feels that his first level seems to be somewhat different from the power of a tiger described in Haishan Jue.
“I can kill a lot of tigers. "
Xu Qing murmured and felt the spiritual energy in his body. With his hard training along the way, he seemed to be about to reach the second level.
“Tonight, attack the second level. "Xu Qing's eyes showed determination, she closed her eyes and began to vomit.
Soon spiritual energy was pouring in from all directions. The spiritual energy outside the restricted area was much less heterogeneous than that inside the restricted area, which resulted in a relatively faster cultivation speed.
Xu Qing had already noticed this in the row room of the Colosseum yesterday.
At this moment, he let go of his body, absorbing and exhaling vigorously, and the faint purple light on his chest, which was covered by his leather jacket, flickered.
As time passed, Xu Qing gradually heard a slight banging sound in his body, and black impurities were once again discharged from his sweat pores.
The flesh and blood in the whole body seems to be getting stronger and tougher as it is nourished, and there is a faintly stronger power, gradually bursting out within it.
At the same time, in the night outside, the little girl who had been exchanged for bamboo sticks by Xu Qing during the day approached the courtyard of Xu Qing's residence.
She stood there hesitantly, as if she wanted to knock on the door, but she was a little uneasy.
After a long time, she seemed to muster up the courage and knocked gently on the bamboo door of the courtyard, but the sound was too weak and could not be transmitted in at all.
And at the moment when the little girl knocked on the bamboo door, the banging sound in Xu Qing's body reached its strongest point.
